lemma one_le_of_ne_zero {n : ℕ} {k : Fin n} :
    haveI : NeZero n := k.neZero_of_exists
    k ≠ 0 → 1 ≤ k := by
  intro hk
  -- establish `[NeZero n]` locally for lemmas below
  haveI : NeZero n := k.neZero_of_exists
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne n)
  cases n with
  | zero => simp only [Fin.isValue, Fin.zero_le]
  | succ n =>
      rwa [Fin.le_iff_val_le_val, Fin.val_one, Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero, val_ne_zero_iff]
